RagShortTexts: Tyre resisted Saladin behind artificial causesways, anchoring premier crusader maritime.

Variants.Content: Projecting into the Mediterranean, Tyre stood as Christendom's most formidable fortress-port following Hattin. Linked to the mainland by a narrow causeway, its sea-washed ramparts resisted Saladin and sheltered deep Venetian trade docks.
Governed by the Montfort lords, Tyre's maritime catapult batteries guarded crucial supply arteries between Acre, Beirut, and Cyprus.
